name: Pickup
description: A drop of the hive's own note: the one place it reaches the player, so it is still the only bright rising thing in the set, but a plink rather than a beep. A triangle that lifts a third and dies away, with a sine a fifth above it at `hush` for the glint. It fires in streams — a magnet pulls a whole field in at once — so it is built to pile up into a shimmer: no harmonics to Nyquist, an onset that does not click, a pitch that wobbles a little rather than a lot, and no more than a dozen of it a second.
